doors.note: Brand trades as 'Sachin & Babi' (domain sachinandbabi.com). No stockist locator. Two consumer-facing, appointment-only showrooms (paid $50 appointment, sells direct incl. preorder) — counted as own-door but FLAG: by-appointment showrooms, not walk-in stores; reviewer may exclude. NYC showroom address not published (page says 'Midtown Manhattan').

craft_evidence.owned: claimed and placed — 'By owning a family-run factory in Mumbai, we are able to control the design and production process from start to finish'; Karigar capsule 'crafted in our Mumbai atelier by master
craft_evidence.madein: 0% by country — every sampled PDP says 'Imported'
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — founders met at FIT 1994; first ready-to-wear 2009; Madison Avenue flagship 2011; CFDA 2013
craft_evidence.process: thin — 'hand-embroidered' and 'master artisans' on Karigar pieces; no process steps
craft_evidence.reasoning: The about page claims an owned, family-run factory in Mumbai and the Karigar capsule places hand embroidery in that atelier. Product pages say only 'Imported' and the factory isn't shown, so it's a claimed-and-placed 3; a shown factory and a Made-in-India statement on the PDPs would argue for 4.
